evidence.quote: Cashel (80 ft. light steel), Wicklow (80 ft. light steel), Mt. St. Patrick (80 ft. light steel), Myer's Cave (80 ft. light steel), Methuen (wooden) and Matawatchan (80 ft. light steel) Towers were built in 1922.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register spells the name Matawachan; the township history and the Tweed district history use Matawatchan. The record keeps the register spelling.

sources.title: Ontario Fire Towers, old towers page with Tower History Notes (Tweed Fire District)

notes_for_editor: The 1922 build year and the 80 ft height rest on one fan-run history page (geocities.ws), not an official record; the register gives no year and no height. The 24.4 m height is converted from the list's 80 ft and may not match the cab floor. The name is spelled Matawachan in the register and Matawatchan in the local sources; the record keeps the register spelling. No source describes the tower's present condition, access or rental, so the story ends on what no source says. Worth a human check against Ontario archive or Renfrew County sources before publication.
